full_prompt_en: The image is a square painted character study of a masked figure shown from the upper body against an aged wall. The figure turns three-quarters toward the left but looks back toward the viewer through circular glass or metal eye pieces. A dull bronze mechanical mask covers the face, with a long angular central ridge, fitted side plates, dark vents, and two round lenses. The upper head is capped by a worn metal helmet whose seams and scratched surface catch pale light. One ear remains visible behind the mask, making the strange face covering feel attached to a human body. A high muted red coat rises around the neck and shoulders. Its thick collar opens to show a dark inner garment with a vertical row of small warm metal buttons. The right shoulder fills much of the foreground, rendered in broad dusty rose and maroon brush marks. Behind the figure, a brown-gray wall has shallow rectangular panel lines. Its surface is stained and scuffed, but it stays quiet enough to support the strong silhouette. Light falls softly from the upper left, striking the helmet, mask ridge, and shoulder while the neck and lower torso sink toward shadow. The palette is limited to old bronze, charcoal, faded red, and warm gray. Paint is visibly worked: broad strokes shape the coat, narrower strokes and small scratches describe metal, and rough color patches break the background. There is no dramatic action or elaborate setting. The upright, reserved pose gives the figure a watchful presence. The composition concentrates on the contrast between hard engineered facial planes and softer worn cloth, with a dense but controlled painterly surface making both materials tangible.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形人物绘画研究，一名戴面具的人以上身出现在陈旧墙前。身体以三分之四角度朝左，却透过圆形玻璃或金属眼部回望观者。暗铜色机械面具覆盖脸部，有长而棱角分明的中央脊、贴合的侧板、深色通气口和两只圆镜片。头上是旧金属头盔，接缝与划伤表面接住浅光。面具后仍可见一只耳朵，使奇异面罩与人的身体相连。暗红外套的高领围住颈肩。厚领口打开，露出深色内衣与一列小暖金属纽扣。右肩占据前景许多空间，由宽阔的灰玫红和栗红笔痕塑造。身后褐灰色墙上有浅浅矩形护板线。表面有污渍和擦痕，却足够安静以衬托强剪影。柔光从左上落下，照到头盔、面罩中脊和肩，颈及下方躯干则沉向阴影。配色局限于旧铜、炭灰、褪色红与暖灰。颜料明显经过经营：宽笔触塑造外套，较窄笔痕和小划痕描绘金属，粗糙色斑打断背景。没有激烈动作或复杂场景。直立而克制的姿态给人物警觉的存在感。构图集中于坚硬工程化面部平面和较柔旧布之间的对照，密而受控的绘画表面使两种材料都可触。
style_prompt_en: Painterly character rendering combines worn metal, heavy cloth, and distressed plaster through visibly different brush marks. Old bronze, charcoal, faded red, and warm gray form a restricted, muted palette. Hard edges and tiny scratches define engineered surfaces; broader dry strokes describe shoulders and fabric. Soft side light selects a few ridges and high planes, leaving recesses dark rather than fully revealing every detail. A quiet paneled or mottled ground holds the silhouette without distracting ornament. The composition stays close and upright, with a watchful stillness. Material contrast and worked paint texture supply the drama, producing an austere, aged, slightly ominous effect.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式人物塑造通过明显不同的笔痕结合磨损金属、厚布与破旧灰泥。旧铜、炭灰、褪色红和暖灰组成局限而暗淡的配色。硬边与细小划痕界定工程化表面；较宽干笔触描绘肩与布料。柔和侧光挑出少数隆起和高平面，让凹处保持深暗，而非揭开全部细节。安静的护板或斑驳底面承托剪影，不以装饰分散注意。构图保持近而直立，带警觉的静止感。材料对比与反复经营的颜料肌理提供戏剧性，形成严厉、陈旧且略不祥的效果。
theme_en: A masked figure in a muted red coat against an old paneled wall
theme_zh: 一名戴金属面具、穿暗红外套的人立于旧护墙前
name: Dishonored
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
